runner: run_starvla_libero.py: the loop of InternVLA-M1 eval_libero.py with its own client class (internvla_m1); model in InternVLA-M1 deployment/model_server (server_policy_M1.py) via starvla_server_launcher.py
env_seed: env.seed(7) per task env; np.random.seed(7) once
max_steps: episode_lengths per suite if set, else --env.episode_length in the extra flags if set, else LeRobot defaults (spatial 280, object 280, goal 300, libero_10 520)
note: InternVLA-M1, per-suite checkpoint InternRobotics/InternVLA-M1-LIBERO-Long (as in the paper); base VLM built from its config (weights from the checkpoint)
policy_settings: as stored in the checkpoint (policy_config.json) unless overridden by the extra flags
